nodeTypes.name: Repository
nodeTypes.description: A git repository, the anchor for most of the graph.

properties.name: url
properties.description: The git remote, in any form; stored canonicalised as https://host/org/name

properties.name: host
properties.description: Host of the remote, e.g. github.com. Derived from url

properties.name: org
properties.description: Owning organisation or user. Derived from url

properties.name: name
properties.description: Repository name within its organisation. Derived from url

properties.name: defaultBranch
properties.description: The branch changes are merged into

properties.name: topics
properties.description: Topics the forge lists for the repository; may be empty

properties.name: codeowners
properties.description: Owners named in its CODEOWNERS file, as written there

properties.name: serviceId
properties.description: The service it provides, as an id, from before the PROVIDES edge

properties.name: language
properties.description: Its main language, as the forge detects it

properties.name: description
properties.description: The one-line description the forge shows for it

properties.name: visibility
properties.description: Who may read it, as the forge reports it

properties.name: packageNames
properties.description: Package names this repository publishes

properties.name: provider
properties.description: Who assigns providerId. Derived from url on github.com and gitlab.com

properties.name: providerId
properties.description: The provider's stable id for the repository, such as GitHub's numeric repository id

questions: Which team owns this repository?
What does it depend on, and what depends on it?
Which pipelines build it and where is it deployed?

nodeTypes.name: Team
nodeTypes.description: A group that owns repositories, services or infrastructure.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The team's name as its organisation spells it, or host/org/slug from GitHub

properties.name: email
properties.description: An address that reaches the whole team

questions: What does this team own?
Which of its repositories changed or failed recently?

nodeTypes.name: Service
nodeTypes.description: A running logical component, which may span more than one repository.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The service's name, unique across the organisation

properties.name: description
properties.description: What the service does, in a sentence

properties.name: tier
properties.description: Criticality tier, platinum the most critical

questions: Which repositories provide this service?
What does it depend on, and who owns it?

nodeTypes.name: Pipeline
nodeTypes.description: A CI/CD workflow definition.

properties.name: provider
properties.description: The CI system that runs it

properties.name: repoKey
properties.description: Key of the repository holding the workflow

properties.name: workflowPath
properties.description: Path of the workflow file in that repository

properties.name: name
properties.description: The workflow's display name, or its file name

properties.name: repoId
properties.description: Key of the repository holding the workflow, from before repoKey

properties.name: lastRunStatus
properties.description: How its most recent run ended, as far as the graph was told

questions: Which pipelines build this repository?
Did its last run succeed?

nodeTypes.name: Artifact
nodeTypes.description: A built, addressable output such as a container image.

properties.name: registry
properties.description: The registry host it is published to, e.g. ghcr.io

properties.name: name
properties.description: Its name in the registry, without the host

properties.name: digest
properties.description: Immutable content digest, preferred for identity

properties.name: version
properties.description: The tag or version it was published as, or its digest

properties.name: commitSha
properties.description: The commit it was built from

properties.name: repoId
properties.description: Key of the repository it was built from, from before BUILT_FROM

properties.name: artifactType
properties.description: What kind of artifact it is

properties.name: identityQuality
properties.description: How sure its key is: digest, or version-only when it is keyed name:version for want of one. Derived

questions: Which commit and repository was this artifact built from?
Where has it been deployed?

nodeTypes.name: Deployment
nodeTypes.description: One event of putting an artifact into an environment.

properties.name: artifactKey
properties.description: Key of the artifact that was deployed

properties.name: environmentKey
properties.description: Key of the environment it was deployed to

properties.name: deployedAt
properties.description: When the deployment happened, in UTC

properties.name: artifactId
properties.description: Key of the deployed artifact, from before artifactKey

properties.name: environmentId
properties.description: Key of the target environment, from before environmentKey

properties.name: deployedBy
properties.description: Who or what started the deployment

properties.name: status
properties.description: How the deployment ended, or that it has not yet

questions: What was deployed where, and when?
Why did this deployment fail?

nodeTypes.name: Environment
nodeTypes.description: A deployment target such as staging or production.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The environment's name; prod and production are one

properties.name: type
properties.description: What kind of environment this is

properties.name: tier
properties.description: Criticality, for ranking impact; read as other where absent

questions: What is deployed to this environment?
What would a change reaching it affect?

nodeTypes.name: CloudResource
nodeTypes.description: An infrastructure object in AWS, Azure or GCP.

properties.name: provider
properties.description: The cloud the resource lives in

properties.name: resourceId
properties.description: ARN, Azure resource id or GCP asset name

properties.name: resourceType
properties.description: The kind of resource, in the cloud's own terms

properties.name: name
properties.description: The resource's human-facing name

properties.name: region
properties.description: The region it is deployed in, where it has one

properties.name: accountId
properties.description: The account, subscription or project that holds it

properties.name: repoId
properties.description: Key of the owning repository, from before OWNS_RESOURCE

questions: Which repository or team owns this resource?
What would a change to it affect?

nodeTypes.name: ConfigurationItem
nodeTypes.description: A configuration item from a service management system such as ServiceNow.

properties.name: sourceSystem
properties.description: The service-management tool it was read from

properties.name: instance
properties.description: Instance of that tool the CI belongs to

properties.name: sysId
properties.description: Identifier of the CI in the source system

properties.name: ciName
properties.description: The CI's name as the CMDB shows it

properties.name: ciClass
properties.description: The CMDB class of the CI, e.g. cmdb_ci_service

properties.name: serviceId
properties.description: The service it corresponds to, from before RELATES_TO_CI

properties.name: operationalStatus
properties.description: As the CMDB reports it, e.g. Operational or Retired

properties.name: environment
properties.description: The environment the CMDB places it in, as written there

properties.name: businessCriticality
properties.description: As the CMDB reports it, e.g. 1 - most critical

properties.name: ownerGroup
properties.description: The group the CMDB names as its owner

properties.name: supportGroup
properties.description: The group that answers for it when it breaks

properties.name: number
properties.description: The human-facing identifier, where the CI has one

questions: Which repository or service does this CI correspond to?
Who supports it, and how critical is it?

nodeTypes.name: ChangeRequest
nodeTypes.description: A change as a service-management tool records it, with its approval and window.

properties.name: sourceSystem
properties.description: The service-management tool it was read from

properties.name: instance
properties.description: Instance of that tool the change belongs to

properties.name: sysId
properties.description: Identifier of the change in the source system

properties.name: number
properties.description: The human-facing identifier, e.g. CHG0001

properties.name: shortDescription
properties.description: The change's one-line summary

properties.name: state
properties.description: As the tool reports it, e.g. Implement or Closed

properties.name: changeType
properties.description: How the change is governed: pre-approved, assessed or urgent

properties.name: risk
properties.description: The risk the tool assessed for it, as written there

properties.name: startDate
properties.description: Start of the planned window

properties.name: endDate
properties.description: End of the planned window

properties.name: closeCode
properties.description: How the change was closed, as the tool reports it

properties.name: requestedBy
properties.description: Who asked for the change, as the tool names them

properties.name: assignmentGroup
properties.description: The group assigned to carry out the change

nodeTypes.name: Incident
nodeTypes.description: An operational failure as a service-management tool records it.

properties.name: sourceSystem
properties.description: The service-management tool it was read from

properties.name: instance
properties.description: Instance of that tool the incident belongs to

properties.name: sysId
properties.description: Identifier of the incident in the source system

properties.name: number
properties.description: The human-facing identifier, e.g. INC0001

properties.name: shortDescription
properties.description: The incident's one-line summary

properties.name: state
properties.description: As the tool reports it, e.g. In Progress or Resolved

properties.name: priority
properties.description: The priority the tool gives it, as written there

properties.name: severity
properties.description: The severity the tool gives it, as written there

properties.name: openedAt
properties.description: When the incident was opened

properties.name: resolvedAt
properties.description: When the incident was resolved, if it has been

properties.name: closeCode
properties.description: How the incident was closed, as the tool reports it

properties.name: assignmentGroup
properties.description: The group assigned to resolve the incident

nodeTypes.name: Library
nodeTypes.description: A third-party package a repository depends on, as its ecosystem names it.

properties.name: ecosystem
properties.description: The package ecosystem; Gradle dependencies are maven

properties.name: name
properties.description: The package name as the manifest spells it

properties.name: description
properties.description: What the package does, in a sentence

nodeTypes.name: IacFile
nodeTypes.description: An infrastructure-as-code file, and the resources it names.

properties.name: repoKey
properties.description: Key of the repository holding the file

properties.name: path
properties.description: Path within the default branch

properties.name: format
properties.description: The infrastructure-as-code language of the file

properties.name: resourceRefs
properties.description: Identifiers the file names literally, for the link engine to match on

nodeTypes.name: Change
nodeTypes.description: A commit range or merge in a repository, identified there by its head sha.

properties.name: repositoryKey
properties.description: Key of the repository the change was made in, e.g. github.com/acme/payments

properties.name: sha
properties.description: The commit the change ends at, stored in lower case

properties.name: baseSha
properties.description: The commit the change starts from, for a range

properties.name: title
properties.description: The change's summary, such as its commit subject

properties.name: author
properties.description: Who made the change, as the forge names them

properties.name: committedAt
properties.description: When the change was committed

properties.name: url
properties.description: Where the change can be read, e.g. the commit or compare page

questions: Where is this change live?

nodeTypes.name: PullRequest
nodeTypes.description: A proposal to merge a change into a repository, as the forge records it.

properties.name: repositoryKey
properties.description: Key of the repository the pull request targets

properties.name: number
properties.description: The forge's number for it within the repository

properties.name: url
properties.description: Where the pull request can be read on the forge

properties.name: title
properties.description: The pull request's title

properties.name: state
properties.description: Whether it is open, merged or closed unmerged

properties.name: mergedAt
properties.description: When it was merged, if it has been

properties.name: branch
properties.description: The head branch, e.g. chorus/CH-42-retry-webhook

nodeTypes.name: ExternalWorkItem
nodeTypes.description: A task, ticket or issue in the system that owns it, referred to by its URI.

properties.name: uri
properties.description: e.g. chorus://task/01J... or https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/PAY-42

properties.name: system
properties.description: The system that owns the work item

properties.name: externalKey
properties.description: Its human-facing identifier there, e.g. CH-42

properties.name: title
properties.description: The work item's title in the owning system

questions: Where is this work item live?

nodeTypes.name: Ontology
nodeTypes.description: Records which ontology version the graph was built with.

properties.name: version
properties.description: The ontology version, as version.yaml declares it

properties.name: loadedAt
properties.description: When a build first recorded this version

nodeTypes.name: SyncRun
nodeTypes.description: One execution of a connector, for auditing what a sync changed.

properties.name: id
properties.description: The run's id, stamped on the provenance of what it wrote

properties.name: connector
properties.description: The connector that ran, by its registered name

properties.name: sourceSystem
properties.description: What this run stamped on the provenance of everything it wrote

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Whether it read everything, what changed, or one delivery

properties.name: sourceId
properties.description: The source system's id for the delivery that caused this run

properties.name: startedAt
properties.description: When the run started

properties.name: finishedAt
properties.description: When the run finished, if it has

properties.name: status
properties.description: Whether the run is going, worked, partly worked or failed

properties.name: nodesUpserted
properties.description: Nodes the run created or updated

properties.name: edgesUpserted
properties.description: Edges the run created or updated

properties.name: tombstones
properties.description: Facts this run closed because the source stopped reporting them

properties.name: watermark
properties.description: Where the next incremental run should start

properties.name: error
properties.description: Why the run failed or partly failed, where it did

nodeTypes.name: ConnectorState
nodeTypes.description: What the graph remembers about a connector between runs.

properties.name: connector
properties.description: The connector this state belongs to

properties.name: watermark
properties.description: Reported by the last successful run

properties.name: lastRunId
properties.description: The last scheduled or manual run to finish, whatever its status

properties.name: lastStatus
properties.description: That run's status; the same as lastRunStatus, kept for states written before it

properties.name: lastRunStatus
properties.description: How the last run to finish ended

properties.name: lastFinishedAt
properties.description: When the last run to finish finished

properties.name: lastSuccessAt
properties.description: When the last successful run finished

properties.name: consecutiveFailures
properties.description: Runs that ended PARTIAL or FAILED since the last SUCCESS

nodeTypes.name: NodeVersion
nodeTypes.description: The values a node held for an interval before they were replaced.

properties.name: versionOf
properties.description: The id of the node these values belonged to

properties.name: since
properties.description: When the node began to hold these values

properties.name: until
properties.description: When a write replaced them, or the node was retired

properties.name: retired
properties.description: True when the values ended because the node was retired rather than changed

properties.name: retiredReason
properties.description: Why the node was retired, where it was

nodeTypes.name: OntologyMigration
nodeTypes.description: A versioned migration of the graph's data, and when it was applied.

properties.name: version
properties.description: The ontology version the migration brings the graph to

properties.name: name
properties.description: The migration's name, from its file name

properties.name: checksum
properties.description: SHA-256 of the file that was applied

properties.name: appliedAt
properties.description: When it was applied or recorded

properties.name: durationMs
properties.description: How long it took to run, in milliseconds

properties.name: baseline
properties.description: True when recorded without running, because the graph never needed it

nodeTypes.name: ServicePrincipal
nodeTypes.description: A connector or agent registered as a principal of its own, owned by a team.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The client id its tokens carry (azp, or client_id)

properties.name: ownedBy
properties.description: Key of the Team that answers for it; recorded on its writes as onBehalfOfTeam

properties.name: description
properties.description: What the principal is for, in a sentence
examples: Reports deployments of the payments service

examples.name: payments-deployer
examples.description: Reports deployments of the payments service

edgeTypes.name: OWNED_BY
edgeTypes.description: Ownership of a repository, service or cloud resource by a team.

properties.name: pathPatterns
properties.description: CODEOWNERS patterns the owner was named against, where ownership came from a file

edgeTypes.name: OWNS_RESOURCE
edgeTypes.description: A repository or service is responsible for a piece of infrastructure.

properties.name: rule
properties.description: What the ownership rests on: stated by hand, or the link rule that proposed it

edgeTypes.name: DEPENDS_ON
edgeTypes.description: A dependency between repositories, services or third-party libraries.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: What sort of dependency this is

properties.name: manifest
properties.description: File the dependency was read from, with its path from the repository root in a monorepo

properties.name: version
properties.description: The version the manifest asks for, as written

properties.name: scope
properties.description: Whether the dependency is needed to run or only to build

properties.name: relType
properties.description: The source system's own name for the relationship, e.g. a CMDB's 'Depends on::Used by'

edgeTypes.name: CONTAINS_IAC
edgeTypes.description: A repository holds an infrastructure-as-code file.

edgeTypes.name: HAS_PIPELINE
edgeTypes.description: A repository defines a CI/CD pipeline.

edgeTypes.name: RELATES_TO_CI
edgeTypes.description: A repository or service corresponds to a configuration item in service management.

edgeTypes.name: AFFECTS
edgeTypes.description: A change or an incident concerns a configuration item, service or repository.

edgeTypes.name: CAUSED_BY
edgeTypes.description: An incident is attributed to a change.

edgeTypes.name: BUILT_FROM
edgeTypes.description: An artifact was built from a repository at a particular commit.

properties.name: commitSha
properties.description: The commit the artifact was built from

edgeTypes.name: DEPLOYED_TO
edgeTypes.description: An artifact was the subject of a deployment.

edgeTypes.name: PROVIDES
edgeTypes.description: A repository provides a running service.

properties.name: path
properties.description: The directory the service is built from, relative to the repository root; absent for the whole repository

edgeTypes.name: INTRODUCED_IN
edgeTypes.description: A change was made in a repository.

edgeTypes.name: MERGES
edgeTypes.description: A pull request merged a change.

edgeTypes.name: CONTAINS
edgeTypes.description: An artifact was built with a change in it.

edgeTypes.name: IMPLEMENTS
edgeTypes.description: A change implements a work item in the system that owns it.

edgeTypes.name: TRACKED_IN
edgeTypes.description: A work item is tracked by a team.

edgeTypes.name: PRODUCED
edgeTypes.description: A sync run asserted this node.

properties.name: sourceSystem
properties.description: The system of record, one sources.yaml declares: manual, github, servicenow and so on

properties.name: sourceId
properties.description: The fact's identifier in that system, when it has one

properties.name: ingestedAt
properties.description: When the graph recorded the fact

properties.name: observedAt
properties.description: When the source says the fact was true

properties.name: confidence
properties.description: 1.0 when reported by the system of record, lower when derived by a rule

properties.name: inferred
properties.description: True when a rule derived the fact rather than a source reporting it

properties.name: validFrom
properties.description: When the fact started to hold, as far as the graph knows

properties.name: validTo
properties.description: Set when the fact is superseded

properties.name: syncRunId
properties.description: The sync run that wrote the fact, where a connector did

properties.name: writtenBy
properties.description: The subject of the principal that made the write, or a service principal's name

properties.name: principalType
properties.description: The kind of that principal

properties.name: onBehalfOfTeam
properties.description: The key of the Team a service principal acted for; absent for a user

properties.name: previousKeys
properties.description: Keys this node had before it was renamed, oldest first

sources.name: manual
sources.description: Stated through the API by the principal that made the write. Needs graph:write only

sources.name: github
sources.description: Repositories, teams, manifests and ownership read from GitHub by the GitHub connector

sources.name: github-actions
sources.description: Pipelines, artifacts and deployments reported by GitHub Actions workflows (POST /api/v1/ingest/deployment)

sources.name: servicenow
sources.description: Configuration items, change requests and incidents read from ServiceNow by the ServiceNow connector

sources.name: aws
sources.description: Cloud resources read from AWS. Declared for the AWS connector; none ships yet

sources.name: dogfood-seed
sources.description: What the dogfood seed job reads from this repository (POST /api/v1/ingest/seed)

sources.name: sdlc-knowledge-graph
sources.description: The graph's record of itself: the sync runs and connector states it keeps

environments.name: production
environments.description: What customers use; a change reaching it matters most

environments.name: staging
environments.description: The last stop before production, run like it

environments.name: development
environments.description: Where changes are first deployed and tried

environments.name: testing
environments.description: Where automated and manual tests run against a deployment
